en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tranquil garden lake with a small pavilion on an islet topped by a tall palm tree. Ducks or swans swim in the water, there is a bridge on the left, and dense trees in the background. In the foreground on the right stands a young girl by the water's edge. The caption at the bottom reads "ALEXANDRIA. - In the Nouzha Garden." and there is a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" across the lower right portion.
